$description: Typography tokens. Utility-led with a warm accent. Two families: a system sans for reading, and a monospace for small terminal-style labels and dates.

families.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
families.notes: System stacks load instantly and are fully legible. No web fonts to download, which keeps the page light and readable on any device.

scale.name: Minor Third
scale.rationale: Base set above the 16px minimum for comfortable reading. Minor Third gives balanced, clear steps for short sections.

measure.rule: Keep paragraphs to 2-3 sentences. Use short headings and lists to break up text.
